wholeExpectation.observablePerformanceDe: Ordnet den konkreten Fehler einer Teilung zu und verfolgt die vier Gameten nachvollziehbar.
wholeExpectation.observablePerformanceEn: Locates the specific error and traces all four gametes.

allPositiveExpectationFacets.scientificReason: Meiosis-I homolog missegregation gives 24/24/22/22 gametes; meiosis-II failure in one cell gives23/23/24/22. Adding a normal23 gamete establishes the changed human chromosome counts.

wholeExpectation.observablePerformanceEn: Calculates gamete/zygote counts and explains at least two possible numerical outcomes.

allPositiveExpectationFacets.scientificReason: The XY/0 versus X/X/YY/0 examples distinguish the division that failed and sex-chromosome composition without turning a genome mutation into a base mutation.
